reviewedFacts: The predecessor Phase-6 authority, AUTH start token and V272 reservation are hash and byte pinned.
The backend and frontend dwp-dev heads and trees are pinned to the observed clean integration bases.
The existing AUTH implementation branch is pinned to its pushed original commit and exact seventeen-path boundary.
Only two existing Auth control-plane source files and their two existing focused tests are added.
The prepare operation is explicitly read-only and may not append activity or grant admission.
Authorization occurs only after proof verification and must preserve the V271 DrainAdmission contract.
The current authority fence, credential lease, local role and workload binding must be rechecked before execution and callback.
No migration, People source, People handshake-before-order, menu, activation, tenant, credential or production authority is granted.
The AUTH branch may be amended and force-pushed only with force-with-lease after the named compile and tests pass.
Direct backend dwp-dev integration remains prohibited pending a separate central review.

residualSourceFindings.finding: The original AUTH implementation cannot yet perform a proof-first local DRAIN admission through the existing public control-plane contract.
Current-lease, local-role and authority-fence parity must be demonstrated at both task execution and callback boundaries.

nonClaims: This review does not claim that the source findings are fixed.
